items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Yeah. That's, that was another old buddy of mine too. Yeah, he was 100 percent.

ctx.x: Yeah. That's, that was another old buddy of mine too. Yeah, he was 100 percent. I just happened to come back when he brought back Dud. I met him when I was down at 'Bama State, and then after that in New York. Yeah, a 100 percent trumpet player. And he had beautiful ideas. The same, you know, we had the growl voice all the time.
Now, you're going for a sweet man. The trumpet player that had the sweetest music and that's what he tried to do. He was living down in Greensboro, South Carolina now.
